name: Headlong
description: Gives agents persistent agency through a self-guided think loop that keeps running between user interactions. Open-source microharness whose core is under 10K lines of Bash.

skills.name: Continuous Think Loop
skills.description: Keeps an agent reasoning and acting on its own between user turns instead of idling until the next prompt arrives.

skills.name: Minimal Harness
skills.description: Runs the whole agent loop from a compact Bash core that is small enough to read end to end and modify directly.

skills.name: Interaction Handoff
skills.description: Interleaves self-directed work with user interactions, carrying context forward across both modes of operation.
